data.name: Poker Clicker
data.detailed_description:
Click fast. Deal cards. Chase massive Chip totals.

Poker Clicker is an arcade-style clicker where every click deals a fresh 5-card poker hand, scores winning combinations, and drives your Chip total higher. From Jacks or Better to Royal Flush, every hand can push your run further.

Earn Deals with every click, spend them on upgrades, boost each hand type with stronger multipliers, and build long-term momentum through milestone bonuses. Hold your Deals for extra Deal Power or spend them for permanent growth — the choice is yours.

Unlock PERKS by collecting specific card combinations from your Steam Inventory. Activate up to 3 at once for permanent bonuses — cheaper upgrades, stronger multipliers, or a head start of bonus deals at the beginning of every run.

As you play, tradable and marketable Playing Cards drop directly into your Steam Inventory every 3 hours of playtime. Browse your collection in the built-in DECK, and submit your own card designs to the Steam Workshop for a chance to see them in the game. For maximum speed, buy and activate Autodeal with the Autoclicker DLC.

Key Features:

  • Arcade clicker gameplay with poker-based scoring.

  • Upgrade hand multipliers and scale your score higher.

  • Use milestone bonuses and Deal Power to optimize growth.

  • Unlock PERKS from card combinations for permanent run bonuses.

  • Browse your Steam Inventory in the built-in DECK overlay.

  • Submit card designs to the Steam Workshop for community review.

  • Compete on the global leaderboard.

  • Collect Playing Cards dropped into your Steam Inventory every 3 hours of playtime.

  • Optional Autodeal through the Autoclicker DLC.

Playing Card Drop Rates:

  • Common — 71.43%

  • Uncommon — 21.43%

  • Rare — 5.71%

  • Epic — 1.14%

  • Legendary — 0.214%

  • Mythic — 0.057%

  • Royal — 0.014%
